items.label: Evolve VexWork into an Operational Console
items.purpose: Make VexWork capable of representing intentional work plus dynamically derived work-shaped attention from repository/provider-owned populations and operating environments, and make that truth traversable through an experimental relational Terrain that preserves currentness, provenance and typed relationships without becoming another Workgraph owner.

items.label: Derived-work projection foundation
items.purpose: Establish the reusable domain-neutral contract for population, scope, lens, evidence, derived facets, projection and explicit promotion without materializing one Work item per entity.

items.label: Derived attention contract
items.purpose: Source-place the smallest reusable model that keeps entity identity, entity health, derived attention and canonical WorkState distinct while supporting dynamic populations, scopes, lenses, evidence states and reason facets.

items.label: Aggregate and entity projection
items.purpose: Project one derived-work lens from aggregate counts through scopes/groups to exact entities and current evidence without granting effects or duplicating entity truth.

items.label: Derived concern to Work promotion
items.purpose: Define explicit adoption of one derived concern into a canonical Work item with provenance back to entity, lens and evidence, without automatic task generation.

items.label: Patient Zero: VexSite Localization
items.purpose: Prove the derived-work foundation against Vextreme's existing page/arc/localization world so VexWork can answer what remains without a page-per-task Workgraph.

items.label: VexSite page population and arc scope
items.purpose: Bind a reusable VexWork population/scope projection to current Vextreme-owned page, node, group and arc identity without copying every page into Workgraph.

items.label: VexSite localization and modernization lens
items.purpose: Derive current page attention from Vextreme-owned evidence such as source localization, locale coverage, generated currentness, lived proof and modernization debt, grouped by current arc/scope.

items.label: VexSite derived-work lived proof
items.purpose: Demonstrate that current Vextreme evidence can answer what remains, why, and where to descend; link existing foreground Work where present; and promote one derived concern without creating tasks for the whole page population.

items.label: Reusable Operating Domain template
items.purpose: Generalize the patient-zero model into a reusable operating-domain template for capabilities, populations, attention queues, processes and work lenses without domain-specific ownership leakage.

items.label: Operating Domain contract
items.purpose: Define a domain-neutral template boundary for capabilities, populations, lenses, processes and provider/repository evidence while keeping business/entity records outside Workgraph.

items.label: Operational attention queue
items.purpose: Support event/exception-driven attention such as fulfillment, expiry or failure queues without automatically converting every event into durable Work.

items.label: Reusable small-commerce starter
items.purpose: Apply the Operating Domain foundation to a reusable small-commerce starter covering catalog, public storefront/site, sale state, inventory state and fulfillment attention without making VexWork the commerce database.

items.label: Flexible commerce item model
items.purpose: Model stable sellable-item identity and state while allowing images, descriptions, condition, provenance, price, listing URL, sold date and expected shipment date to remain optional unless a selected process requires them.

items.label: AI-managed storefront/site surface
items.purpose: Prove that a human can add or revise an item and its pictures through an AI-assisted environment that updates a rightful managed public site/storefront while VexWork remains the work/navigation console.

items.label: Sale and fulfillment attention
items.purpose: Turn a provider/manual sale observation into truthful inventory/listing state plus bounded fulfillment attention, optional expected shipment date and a human acknowledgement boundary without copying protected customer data into public VexWork source.

items.label: Antique Plate lived commerce pilot
items.purpose: Dogfood the reusable commerce starter for a nontechnical human selling unique antique plates online, from no operating environment through one truthful item sale and physical-shipment acknowledgement.

items.label: Form the antique-store operating environment
items.purpose: Establish the minimum real catalog/storefront/AI-readable operating environment required for the antique-plate pilot, with protected provider/account actions remaining human-owned.

items.label: Publish the first picture-backed antique item
items.purpose: Add one real antique plate, attach real picture evidence, add or edit the details actually known, and publish it through the managed site/storefront while VexWork can explain its readiness and current state.

items.label: Complete one sale through human shipment acknowledgement
items.purpose: Observe or record the first sold item, surface bounded fulfillment attention, optionally track expected shipment date, notify the human of the physical action, accept bounded receipt/photo acknowledgement after shipment, and close the attention truthfully.

items.label: Cross-domain Operational Console completion
items.purpose: Prove that the same underlying VexWork abstraction handles both a large existing VexSite population and a newly formed commerce environment, including dynamic regression, derived attention, promotion and a lived human fulfillment boundary without domain-specific task explosion.

items.label: Multiple fulfiller / nearby-route optimization
items.purpose: Preserve the possible later need for assigning fulfillment to multiple people, grouping nearby deliveries, routing/sequencing stops and collecting worker delivery acknowledgement without making dispatch/routing part of the first commerce-pilot completion boundary.

items.label: VexWork Terrain Map v2
items.purpose: Establish an experimental read-only relational Terrain projection over VexWork truth so humans and AI can traverse Projects, nested Work and typed cross-context relationships with arbitrary semantic depth, preserved structural and traversal context, deterministic continuity and bounded neighborhoods without creating another lifecycle or graph owner.

items.label: Relational Terrain patient-zero
items.purpose: Prove one VexWork-owned Terrain experience with arbitrary-depth semantic traversal, typed containment/dependency/project portals, structural path distinct from traversal path, cycle-safe route planning, serialized idempotent commands, bounded Journey/revisit semantics, nested-scroll arbitration and responsive presentation over the read-only public workspace.

items.label: Currentness and flow Terrain layer
items.purpose: Layer current work, recent accepted transitions, recent completions, newly available work and later honest flow measures onto the same relational Terrain without treating provider activity, layout or incomplete transition-history coverage as canonical progress.
